question: Across a family of workloads that vary only in butterfly route sharing and crossbar bank collisions, which interconnect finishes sooner on the RTL, and where does the fast model pick the wrong one?

x.label: How often paired initiators need the same butterfly route
x.definition: fraction of (initiator pair 2k/2k+1, slot) in which both requests leave stage-1 router k through the same output toward different banks

y.label: How often requests collide on a crossbar bank
y.definition: fraction of (initiator, slot) whose word maps (q mod 8) to a crossbar bank that another initiator also requests in the same slot
y.unit: doubled crossbar-bank slots (each is two colliding requests out of 256)

features_note: Features are nominal: computed from the programs by slot index. Once an initiator stalls, its stream drifts relative to the others, so the executed interaction differs from the nominal one.

scope.acceptance: not part of repair acceptance; the repaired model was frozen and accepted on heldout-v1 and heldout-v2 before this map was defined

evaluation: rift.evaluate.compare/v1 classify: same margin (max(2 cycles, 2% of the smaller cost)) and tie policy as every other comparison

prediction_before_execution.recorded: 2026-10-19, before any map cell was executed
prediction_before_execution.bank_only_model: predicts a butterfly cost of 33 cycles in every cell (no butterfly bank conflicts by construction); its choice therefore depends on crossbar collisions only: a tie with no collisions, the butterfly everywhere else
prediction_before_execution.hardware: crossbar cost grows with crossbar collisions and butterfly cost grows with route sharing; the measured switch-over should lie near the diagonal
prediction_before_execution.wrong_region: strict reversals concentrated where route sharing exceeds crossbar collisions
prediction_before_execution.repaired_model: switch-over close to the measured diagonal; residual disagreements possible near the diagonal because the repaired model uses round-robin rather than LFSR priorities
prediction_before_execution.landmarks: pattern L near (1, 0), pattern B at (0, 1), pattern M near (0.94, 0.06)

landmarks.name: C1
outside_family_because: 9 slots with a butterfly bank conflict
